instruction: Can you remove google-chrome from the favorite applications?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires removing google-chrome from favorite apps. Initial state has [thunderbird, vim, chrome], final state should have [thunderbird, vim]. Uses existing check_gnome_favorite_apps metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts GNOME Shell favorite-apps using gsettings command
Metric check_gnome_favorite_apps uses appropriate set-based comparison for unordered list verification
Expected values ['thunderbird.desktop', 'vim.desktop'] are semantically correct (initial state minus chrome)
Complete coverage: single requirement (remove chrome) is fully verified by checking final favorite-apps list
No postconfig needed: gsettings is a persistent system configuration, not transient UI state
Data flow is correct: command output -> string parsing -> set comparison -> binary score
Logic handles the verification requirement correctly with length check and set equality
